verdict.rationale: User access reviews are a fair question for a compliance automation platform like Drata, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents periodic access review campaigns, in-app reviewer sign-off, or review artifacts flowing into the evidence library. The Evidence Library API, connections, and personnel endpoints are adjacent building blocks, not the access review capability itself.

support.subject: As a security engineer, periodic user access reviews run across connected apps in the platform — reviewers sign off in-app and the artifact lands in the evidence library
